section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) measurement methodology used in the current study. The BAS is a 13-item scale modified to assess body appreciation over the past 24 hours, with participants rating items daily on a 1-5 scale. The sample consisted of college women, and the mean weekly BAS score across participants was 3.37 (SD = 0.76) with Cronbach's alphas ranging from .95 to .96 across study days.
